What's on the board.

Everything here is from the boards over the counter. Ask about sizes, pints and quarts when you come in.

  • Hard ice creamcup or cone, hand packed pints and quarts
  • Soft serve and low fatsmall or large
  • Italian iceby the scoop, pint or quart
  • Sundaes and banana splitsmake your own
  • Milkshakes and ice cream sodassmall, large or thick
  • Slush, smoothies, egg creamfor warm days
  • Ice cream cakesask at the counter
AllergiesIl Bacio is not a nut-free shop, and some products may contain peanuts.
